title: S3 bucket has public access
check_reference: S3 public access block and ACL
gdpr_dpdp: Public exposure can disclose personal data; verify lawful processing and access controls.
rationale: Internet-readable storage can expose confidential data.
remediation: Enable S3 Block Public Access and remove public ACL grants.

title: S3 bucket encryption is not enabled
gdpr_dpdp: Encryption is a recommended safeguard for stored personal data.
rationale: Unencrypted objects are exposed if storage access is compromised.
remediation: Configure SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS default bucket encryption.

title: S3 bucket versioning is disabled
cis: Not directly covered by CIS AWS Foundations 1.5
gdpr_dpdp: Versioning can support recovery and integrity investigations.
rationale: Without versioning, accidental or malicious deletion is harder to recover.
remediation: Enable versioning where recovery requirements justify it.

title: Security group allows SSH or RDP from the internet
gdpr_dpdp: Restricting administrative access reduces unauthorized processing risk.
rationale: Internet-reachable management ports are a common intrusion path.
remediation: Restrict SSH/RDP to approved networks or a private management path.

title: EC2 instance uses an over-permissive role
gdpr_dpdp: Excess privileges increase the impact of an account compromise.
rationale: A compromised workload can use wildcard permissions to access or alter data.
remediation: Replace wildcard permissions with a narrowly scoped instance role.

title: RDS instance is publicly accessible
gdpr_dpdp: Public database exposure can disclose personal data.
rationale: Databases should not accept direct public network connections.
remediation: Disable PubliclyAccessible and use private subnets and controlled access.

title: RDS storage encryption is disabled
gdpr_dpdp: Encryption at rest is an appropriate technical safeguard.
rationale: Unencrypted database storage increases exposure after infrastructure access.
remediation: Create an encrypted replacement instance and migrate data.

title: IAM policy permits privilege escalation
gdpr_dpdp: Least privilege limits unauthorized personal-data processing.
rationale: PassRole, service creation, policy mutation, or wildcard action/resource permissions can elevate access.
remediation: Remove escalation actions, restrict service creation, and scope actions and resources explicitly.
